visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: Doubling Instead of Bit Masks
visualizerParams.problemDescription: A bit mask from 0 to 2^n - 1 selects the items of each subset. Build the subsets by doubling the list for each item, which needs no bit operations. The output must stay the same.

solution.explanation: Adding one item at a time and doubling the list says what a power set is without bit tricks, and it has no limit on the number of items that fit into an integer mask.
